nodes.name: Sign-on screen
nodes.summary: CICS screen where users log in. Checks the user ID and password against the security file and routes to the main menu.

nodes.name: Main menu
nodes.summary: Lists the options a user can pick and transfers control to the matching program.

nodes.name: Account view
nodes.summary: Shows an account's balance, limits and customer details by reading the accounts and customer files.

nodes.name: Card list
nodes.summary: Pages through the credit cards linked to an account.

nodes.name: Bill payment
nodes.summary: Lets a customer pay their balance. Records the payment as a new transaction for the nightly batch to post.

nodes.name: Accounts file
nodes.summary: Master record for every account: balance, credit limit, open date and status.

nodes.name: Cards file
nodes.summary: One record per card, linked to its account.

nodes.name: Transactions file
nodes.summary: Every purchase, payment and interest charge, waiting to be posted or already posted.

nodes.name: Transaction posting
nodes.summary: Nightly batch that validates the day's transactions and posts them to account balances.

nodes.name: Interest calculation
nodes.summary: Calculates monthly interest and posts it to accounts.

nodes.name: Statement generation
nodes.summary: Builds monthly customer statements from accounts and transactions.
